{{nymph|parent=[[Njordr]]}}

Deltaia is the revered goddess of the Rhine-Meuse-Scheldt Delta, one of the most complex and extensive river deltas in Europe. She is known as a multifaceted deity, representing the interwoven nature of the Rhine, Meuse, and Scheldt rivers as they converge and form a vast delta landscape. Deltaia is often depicted as a radiant and serene goddess, with flowing hair that mirrors the intricate network of rivers and distributaries in the delta. She is believed to possess a deep connection with the land and water, overseeing the ever-changing dynamics of the delta's ecosystems and guiding its delicate balance of freshwater and saltwater habitats. Deltaia is also associated with the cultural significance of the Rhine, Meuse, and Scheldt rivers, as they have played a pivotal role in the history, economy, and livelihood of the regions they traverse. She is revered as a guardian and protector of the delta's rich biodiversity, as well as a symbol of resilience and adaptability in the face of constant change. Deltaia is honored with reverence and offerings, and her blessings are sought for sustainable management of the delta's natural resources, preservation of its unique landscapes, and harmonious coexistence between humans and nature in this complex and dynamic ecosystem.
